column1: NOTE: Only admins can change estado via the dropdown in /consultas/[id] detail view. Medicos and recepcionistas must use the dedicated action buttons listed below.

column5: how each role can do it?
All: 'Marcar como ausente' action in /consultas table
Admin: 'Iniciar consulta' action in /consultas table | Medico: 'Iniciar consulta' action in /consultas table (only for own consultas)

Admin: 'Finalizar consulta' button in /consultas/[id] detail view | Medico: 'Finalizar consulta' button in /consultas/[id] detail view (only for own consultas). Requires diagnostico and informe fields.

Admin: 'Cancelar consulta' button in /consultas/[id] detail view | Medico: 'Cancelar consulta' button in /consultas/[id] detail view (only for own consultas). Special case: this transition bypasses the standard transition rules which only allow en_curso → completada. It exists to handle situations where a consultation needs to be cancelled after being started.
